Generate a survey codebook from an instrument object

Source: R/reporting.R
sframe_codebook.Rd

Produces a structured codebook listing all items, their types, choice sets, scale membership, and reverse-coding status. The codebook can be rendered as HTML or Markdown.

Usage

sframe_codebook(instrument, format = c("html", "md"))

Arguments

instrument

An sframe object.

format

Character. Output format. Either "html" or "md". With "md", the codebook also carries itself as Markdown text, in markdown, and print() writes that text.

Value

An object of class sframe_codebook, a list with elements instrument_meta, items_table, choices_table, scales_table, plan_table, models_table and format, and with format = "md", markdown: one character string holding the whole codebook as Markdown, with a pipe table per component. Save it with writeLines(cb$markdown, "codebook.md"). With "html", print() shows a compact summary, and render_report() includes the codebook in a full report.

See also

render_report()

Other Report functions: render_report(), render_results(), sframe_analysis_qmd(), sframe_format_result(), sframe_report_source(), sframe_reports, sframe_save_figures(), sframe_show()

Examples

cs    <- sframe_choice_set("ag5", 1:5,
           c("Strongly disagree", "Disagree", "Neutral",
             "Agree", "Strongly agree"))
i1    <- sframe_item("sat_1", "Item 1", type = "likert",
                 choice_set = "ag5", scale_id = "sat")
i2    <- sframe_item("sat_2", "Item 2", type = "likert",
                 choice_set = "ag5", scale_id = "sat")
scale <- sframe_scale("sat", "Satisfaction", items = c("sat_1", "sat_2"))
instr <- sframe_instrument("Demo Survey", components = list(cs, i1, i2, scale))

cb <- sframe_codebook(instr)
print(cb)
md <- sframe_codebook(instr, format = "md")
cat(substr(md$markdown, 1, 200))
nrow(sframe_get_items(cb))
nrow(sframe_get_scales(cb))
